item-61.reason: The URL changes before the new page renders, leaving a brief window in which the click targets links on the old page.

item-62.reason: The visible status reflects an earlier sync, so the test proceeds while the newly requested content is still missing.

item-63.reason: The download fails because the redirected network request reaches an IPv6 address where the service is not listening.

item-64.reason: A reset socket connection raises an unhandled network error in the fixture server.

item-65.reason: Substring text selectors match several elements instead of identifying the intended one.

item-66.reason: The option click races the dropdown's asynchronous poller fetch because the test does not wait for it.

item-67.reason: An unscoped button locator also matches the Dev Tools button when it appears.

item-68.reason: The page-wide link locator became ambiguous after another New session link was added.

item-69.reason: An over-broad selector matches footnotes before the intended feed rows render.

item-70.reason: A fixed wall-clock delay does not allow enough simulation ticks on a slower runner.

item-71.reason: A refetch replaces the matched row during the brief window before its button is clicked.

item-72.reason: A transient lack of focus and slower Tab traversal make the fixed traversal loop time out.

item-73.reason: The locator targets an obsolete headline and therefore finds no element.

item-74.reason: The earlier toast remains visible briefly and makes the next toast locator ambiguous.

item-75.reason: The assertion can read the old layout before the resize listener runs on a later frame.

item-76.reason: The test can miss the on-mount request and interact with the form before both required fetches finish.

item-77.reason: The substring label locator matches both the main form input and the newly added footer input.

item-78.reason: The server-rendered disabled state passes the readiness check before the carousel's click handlers are attached.

item-79.reason: The outgoing row and incoming done row coexist during an animation, making the title locator ambiguous.

item-80.reason: An asynchronous update replaces the radio input after Cypress locates it but before the click.

item-81.reason: The screen's DOM and test IDs changed while the spec still targets the old interface.

item-82.reason: An unscoped text locator briefly matches two Appearance labels and triggers strict mode.

item-83.reason: The scan runs before the first paint settles, so the styles needed for contrast are not ready.

item-84.reason: Sign-in navigation starts before sign-out finishes and cancels the action that would clear the session.

item-85.reason: Keyboard input runs while the old survey has unmounted and the new controls have not rendered.

item-86.reason: The test fills the editor before its asynchronous prefill completes, producing the wrong draft text.

item-87.reason: The page object locator was updated for one client version and no longer matches the released clients' textarea.

item-88.reason: The test adds text before the portrait template finishes loading and changes the canvas layout.

item-89.reason: The link locator uses an obsolete accessible name and finds no link.

item-90.reason: A periodic poll response races the sort response and is mistaken for the response to the click.

item-91.reason: Cold module transforms consume most of the timeout under parallel load, causing a later step to exceed the limit.

item-92.reason: A substring heading locator matches both the Billing heading and the new Billing details heading.

item-93.reason: The helper counts elements before a later element renders and follows a branch based on that transient count.

item-94.reason: The form is temporarily replaced during a data reload, so the next typing command targets an outgoing input.

item-95.reason: The exact accessible-name locator cannot match a menu item whose name also includes a subtitle.
